correctness.rationale: Exact standalone code checks all 462 possible rank-five hyperplane intersections to prove the eleven-vertex description, all 2,048 facet subsets to enumerate 143 nonempty faces, primitive facet-cone rays and lattice indices. Exactly ten maximal singular triangles and 40 singular orbits follow. Each triangle is unimodular; two normal-cone orbit representatives have four primitive rays with a balanced unit relation and all triple bases saturated, yielding transverse uv-wz=0. Pairwise face intersections prove the stated incidence. Standard toric orbit-cone, smoothness and divisor-class theorems convert exact finite checks into geometric conclusions. No infinite extrapolation or undocumented experiment.

value.rationale: The minimal odd hole C5 is the first nonperfect cycle; its stable-set polytope is a canonical nontrivial five-dimensional lattice polytope. This is a natural complete local-singularity classification with ten projective planes in two symmetry orbits, uniformly conifold transverse sections, forty singular orbits and a five-triple-line incidence structure. The exact normal-fan invariants are motivated geometrically, absent from the inspected prior global ring/ideal treatment, and useful for understanding possible toric resolutions and intersection questions.
